scope: Retrospective nominal-USD construction-contract cost estimation from reported building characteristics and completion-reference year. Not an award-time forecast, Saudi quote, total plant cost, or whole-engine acceptance.
feature_availability: Historical design versions are unavailable; reported net/gross areas, capacities, scope and year may reflect as-built outcomes. No claim these were known at tender.
selection: Pooled temporal-fold within-10% rate descending, then mean absolute percentage error ascending, then candidate name. No calibration/test labels used for model selection. Final fit uses development only.
interval: 90% nominal split-conformal multiplicative interval using 2021 calibration residuals after final fitting. Time shift prevents an exchangeability guarantee; report test coverage and width separately from point accuracy.
test_policy: New source and unseen cohort for ACEP. Test labels are parsed for data validity and stored separately, not inspected or used for fitting/model selection. Five distinct facility groups are fixed by ID hash before any model runs.
limits: Completed public-sector Florida facility construction only.
Missing 2022 and 2023 annual workbooks in this cohort; 2024 tests temporal extrapolation.
Facility-name normalization is not verified parcel/site/contractor independence.
Repeated facility groups are purged across heldout partitions.
No initial estimates, execution durations, BOQ quantities, risks, inspections or supplier outcomes are available here.
